name: Mermaid Life
detailed_description:
Mermaid Life is an upcoming third-person life simulation RPG where you can experience the life of a mermaid in a vibrant tropical island and a hidden underwater village. Start your journey as a mermaid adapting to life on land, or begin as a human and uncover your true destiny by exploring the mystical cave. Work, socialize, explore, and shape your own adventure in a world filled with secrets and magic!

Dreaming of exploring the ocean and living as a mermaid?

No problem! Mermaid Life offers an open world with both land and underwater locations to discover. Swim freely through coral reefs, uncover ancient secrets, and interact with marine creatures—all while navigating the challenges of life on land.

What about creating a unique mermaid?

Our character editor allows you to customize your merfolk. choose traits carefully, they may also define your first mermaid curse, but hey, no pressure! Every merfolk goes through it… some just end up as sea foam.

Willing to immerse yourself in an enchanting world and embrace your destiny?

We've got you covered! Take on jobs, build relationships, explore hidden locations, and seek out the Sea Witch, who can grant powerful abilities… but always at a cost. Whether you want to become a legendary merfolk, a master of ocean magic, or live a peaceful land life, the choice is yours.

Looking for an open world full of mystery and adventure?

From sunlit beaches to the depths of the sea, Mermaid Life is filled with hidden places and unique challenges. Visit the underwater village, find secret caves, uncover the truth behind strange merfolk disappearances, or just relax at the local café. Some secrets, however, are better left undisturbed, will you dare to uncover what lies beneath the surface?

This world is your ocean, and you? You’re the pearl!
